summary: PR 7371 reset moduleDisplayName in metadata.json for 576 AVM modules to their canonical values. It merged without recorded reviews.
proposed: The display names had drifted from the canonical names in BicepResourceModules.csv and BicepPatternModules.csv.
changed: Each of 576 files had exactly one line changed to the canonical value from an inventory of 579 drifted rows; three modules already had the canonical value and were left alone. The PR body reports all files parse as JSON and each new value was checked against the inventory.
shipped: The moduleDisplayName corrections merged in one commit; only that field was touched.
